purpose: Diagnostic requested event heap and actual observed allocator calls; no timing claims
scope: Same Server, registry, clients and event protocol handling as each runtime. Retained includes live server/listener/requested queue capacity after drain. Peak and in-flight measured during one complete receive, including constructing its owned input frame; fixture buffers preallocated outside baseline. Successful alloc/zeroed and realloc callbacks counted separately; optimizer may remove calls; diagnostic binary only. 32 KiB matches must queue at 4096-byte socket send buffer; 16-byte matches must send directly. Full payload/order/sequence/status checked with nonallocating drains. Requested layouts exclude allocator rounding/internal realloc overlap, libc, stack/code, socket/kernel buffers, PSS/full peak; does not establish C/R89 memory superiority.
performance_isolation: Run only after all frozen timing windows finish, no overlapping router measurements.
